scripts.04-replicaset: npm run 04-replicaset:db && docker compose -f 04-replicaset/docker-compose.yml up app
scripts.04-replicaset:db: docker compose -f 04-replicaset/docker-compose.yml up -d mongodb-primary mongodb-secondary-1 mongodb-secondary-2 && docker compose -f 04-replicaset/docker-compose.yml run --rm replica-setup
scripts.05-sharding: npm run 05-sharding:db && docker compose -f 05-sharding/docker-compose.yml up app
scripts.05-sharding:db: docker compose -f 05-sharding/docker-compose.yml up -d config-server shard-country-a shard-country-b && docker compose -f 05-sharding/docker-compose.yml run --rm config-setup && docker compose -f 05-sharding/docker-compose.yml run --rm shard-country-a-setup && docker compose -f 05-sharding/docker-compose.yml run --rm shard-country-b-setup && docker compose -f 05-sharding/docker-compose.yml up -d mongos && docker compose -f 05-sharding/docker-compose.yml run --rm sharding-setup
scripts.07-caching:redis: docker compose -f 07-caching/docker-compose.yml up -d redis-node-1 redis-node-2 redis-node-3 redis-node-4 redis-node-5 redis-node-6 && docker compose -f 07-caching/docker-compose.yml run --rm redis-cluster-setup
